core: Both communities assign a numeric threshold to evaluation items or runs, and when an agent's behavior crosses it — exceeding a cap, or falling below the threshold — the case is flagged for further review or audit instead of being silently scored as an ordinary pass or fail. This flagging singles out anomalous cases for closer human attention, distinguishing genuine capability problems from artifacts of the measurement setup itself, rather than folding every crossing directly into an aggregate score.
quote_1: ⟦T1⟧ enforcement flagged eleven runs this week for exceeding the cap
quote_2: Failures below an agent’s ⟦T2⟧ were flagged for audit rather than treated as ordinary misses.
